abilities.pattern: P-B at-least-one constraint (anyOf) — factually-corrective vs installed handler
abilities.notes: Package 5 reviewer-directed correction. Installed handler precedence if($attachment_id) elseif($url) — BOTH accepted (attachment_id wins), only NEITHER rejected. Added input_schema `anyOf:[{required:[attachment_id]},{required:[<url>]}]` (NOT oneOf — oneOf would false-reject the handler-valid both-case, Principle-4 violation). Factually-corrective Principle-10: breaks no working call (neither already failed at handler), false-rejects no handler-valid input, handler untouched. Live-verified representative upload-board-background-image on helenawillow probe (incidental): both-supplied -> reached handler (schema accepted); neither-supplied -> typed schema anyOf rejection pre-handler. Probe restored to parent 44f3991, 0 residue. see docs/P5-SCHEMA-CLARITY.md
abilities.status: RESOLVED in PR #91 (reviewer-directed; anyOf not oneOf; representative live-verified)
